title: polar express sleigh bells
text: polar express sleigh bells. These are spendy - yes... but they are very large and very heavy.  Quite high quality.  I have two grandsons and purchased 3 - one for each of them and 1 for grandma's christmas tree... My oldest is 7 and right on the edge of not believing any longer... so I was hoping to stretch out one more year with these and I think it worked!  :)  They come with beautiful presentation boxes, already wrapped and in dressed in green ribbon - truly ready for gifting right out of the shipping box.  You will not be disappointed in these.  You can certainly purchase cheaper bells... however... I've never seen any better.  These are meant to last a lifetime and be handed down to each generation and hope they will be.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I hope this info was helpful to you.

product_metadata.title: Polar Express Sleigh Bell Gift Set (4 Pack)
features: This is THE First Gift of Christmas. The gift set contains a large silver sleigh bell with premium leather harness strap, velvet gift bag, the red and white striped gift box, the bow and ribbon, and a unique Certificate of Authenticity that has the name of the elf who made your bell, the reindeer who flies with the bell on its harness, etc.

Watch your child's eyes light up when they open this gift on Christmas morning. There is no bell out there more true to the movie and book than this one! No detail has been spared, from the size and shape of the bell, to the size and shape of the box, the stripe pattern on the box (striped inside and out), the bow and the ribbon.
Add our ROUND TRIP ticket or BELIEVE punched ticket at a discounted price when you order this item!

NOTE: while we want you to look around for the perfect bell for you, we are confident you will settle on this bell. No other bell has all the details so true to the original from the bell to the gift box.
Bell is 3" long top to bottom and 2 1/4" in diameter and weighs over 5 oz and ticket is a substantial 8" x 3". The ticket has a slight sparkle to it and is antique gold.
